title: Robinhood CEO Calls for Durable Rules Beyond SEC Tokenization Exemption
why_it_matters: A temporary trading pathway can support experiments, but institutions planning long-lived tokenized equity products still face policy-reversal risk beyond the exemption's five-year term.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Robinhood CEO Calls for Durable Rules Beyond SEC Tokenization Exemption

Vlad Tenev backed the SEC's five-year tokenized-stock exemption but said lasting rulemaking or legislation is needed before customers commit serious assets.
